topic: Feature planning and performance impact discussion
summary_markdown: The conversation focused on the technical feasibility and potential performance impact of a feature outlined in an internal ticket. It was confirmed that for periods shorter than six months, the data is available on the traffic page with minimal speed impact. For longer periods, aggregation must remain at the hourly (H) level rather than switching to daily (D). The initial concern regarding performance speed has been resolved and will be discussed further during the evening release/feature planning meeting.
decisions: The performance impact of the feature was assessed and deemed acceptable for short periods (< 6 months).
Data aggregation for this feature must remain at the hourly level.
action_items: Discuss the feature details with all participants during the evening release/feature planning meeting.
